rationale: Describes concrete district geometry with distinct limbs (body, long skinny neck, curled tail) and gives a fitting animal nickname 'Seahorse'. Also correctly grounds the tradition in 1812 with Governor Elbridge Gerry.
quote: Big round body sitting on the good side of the county, a long skinny neck reaching way up north to grab the two towns I want, and a little curl of a tail down south for the lake.
